files.detail: Main desktop Share gating, shared badge and HeaderBreadcrumb composition removed; replacement is chat-header-view plus runtime header. H1, H2.
Project icon/backlink, title dropdown, inline rename (Enter/Escape/blur), pin/delete/share actions removed. H1.
Retains sticky header classes, mobile sidebar trigger and HeaderActions, but receives plain text rather than main breadcrumb controls. H1.
Plain title/New conversation; unqualified canonical URL; per-chat identity cache not invalidated by list mutations. Accepted observer ownership retained. H1, H3, O1.
Sign-in, documentation and GitHub controls are identical. Missing on EVE project page because its caller bypasses this composition. P1.
Same rename/pin/share/delete menu appearance; adds optional Move to project and optional deletion. Reuse it in restored header rather than building another menu.
Only an explanatory lint suppression differs; dialog presentation is retained. Callers determine optimism/error propagation. O1.

Dialog content extracted into controlled ShareDialogView; awaits visibility and displays failures. Session gating and link-copy UI retained. Native branch versus logical chat sharing remains a deliberate contract.
Wraps main share view with EVE queries; refreshes only its exact identity key and exposes query failure. Does not forward header responsive className. H2.
Shared header is a plain title and New conversation link; main Shared badge/tooltip is absent. Read-only document layout and copy action remain. H2.
Resolves bound conversation and registers logical runtime; header UI now lives in provider. Preserve stable logical identity when restoring metadata controls.
Existing sidebar new-chat button, tooltip and shortcut label retained.
Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+O retained; this component never handled Cmd/Ctrl+K. Search shortcut disappeared with search-chats.tsx. S2.
Existing route parser still distinguishes project/chat/share; history selection bypasses it with last pathname segment. H3, P3.
Already supplies project identity. Sidebar uses it but EVE canonicalization removes project context. H3.
Removed misleading link role from current-page span; no geometry change. Do not revert to fix missing header content.
Empty-project vertical centering, container spacing and dedicated ProjectChats composition removed. Main project rename used optimistic hook. P1, O2.
Top-aligned p-4 layout, desktop sidebar toggle, no HeaderActions, generic history search/empty state. Direct project update waits for server. P1, O2.
Project-specific empty-state card and row separators replaced by generic sidebar-style list. P1.
Same title/date row, menu and rename dialog; accessible link label added, date now optional, Move action and injected share content added. Route link still uses project/chat path that redirects. H3.
Visual icon/name/rename/instructions layout unchanged; decorative plus/check hidden from accessibility name. Screenshot confirms surrounding layout is the main difference.
Same name/icon/color dialog. Create now awaits callback and shows save errors. Captured matched New Project dialogs. Creation was not optimistic on main either. V1.
Extracted main dialog with changed explanatory copy, accessible textarea label, disabled editing/closing during save, explicit failure. Retain error/pending improvements.
Same visual project icon primitive.
Same icon/color chooser and defaults; no evidence this shared component caused layout drift.
Same Rename/Delete menu items.
Retains project-only deletion semantics; awaits success, blocks dismissal while pending, displays error and refreshes EVE history. Does not optimistically remove project (main also waited).
Same create button/list/dialog and server-success navigation; mutateAsync propagates failure. Active project remains pathname-derived, lost after EVE chat redirect. H3.
Only project mutation hook import changes. Existing row/icon/more menu and edit/delete dialogs retained.
Projects moved into bare menu without Projects label/collapsed guard; SearchChatsButton removed; server Suspense loading text replaces main history wrapper. S1, S2.
Lost collapsed guard and skeleton; guest sign-in-only state intentionally differs because EVE supports guest history. Restore presentation without removing guest history. S1.
Projects and Chats group headings/composition removed. S1.
Pinned/date group labels and skeletons removed; main excluded project chats from general sidebar history. EVE includes them. S3.
Server resolves signed-in or guest owner; calls list without project filter. Keep owner separation and guest history. S3.
Flat list + inline search; server-only rename/pin; UUID-last-segment identity query runs on project route and fails; explicit retry/pagination/deletion recovery are additions. P3, S2, S3, O1.
Inline title edit/menu geometry retained; Move and injected share added; memo comparator now includes callback/project changes. Missing optimism is in caller, not this view. O1.
Search sidebar button, tooltip and Cmd/Ctrl+K handler removed. S2.
Main modal/deferred title filtering/results replaced by inline server search. Treat this as changed search interaction, not absence of all search. S2.
Only credits hook import changed; avatar/account/footer composition retained.
Brand and collapse/expand control unchanged.
Existing toggle primitive retained; altered placement comes from callers.
Rail gets type=button; skeleton width fixed at 70% instead of random. Cookie fallback only gains lint explanation. Not responsible for lost project grouping.
Native family/file deletion has confirm/pending/unconfirmed/check/retry phases. Different copy and Dialog vs main AlertDialog; preserve truthful durable cleanup status. O3.
Main simpler AlertDialog and optimistic removal replaced by EVE family deletion controller. Reuse styling where appropriate without falsely claiming completed deletion. O3.
Layout-owned dialog survives mobile sidebar close; family status determines navigation and history refresh. Project return target can be lost after route canonicalization. H3.
New project assignment dialog with native select, pending/error/invalid-target states. Refreshes lists/router but not logical identity metadata. O1.
Sidebar project-name optimism and rollback retained; invalidates broader project namespace. Main only optimistically patched name, not icon/color. O2.
Supplies retained footer credits independently of deleted chat-sync hooks; not a header/project layout replacement.
Main title save/date subtitle, streaming document state, header actions, floating toolbar and previous-version footer removed. D1–D5.
Reuses split panes/editors; adds recovery rows but removes date subtitle/restoration; native conversation key resets panel; hides init preview and forces idle editor status. D1–D6.
Main per-kind header actions, version navigation and action-disabled handling removed. EVE splits controls among several locations. D1.
Copy and text diff toggle retained; previous/next moved below document, code run moved out of header. D1.
Restore this version and Back to latest version have no EVE UI equivalent. Previous/Next alone does not replace them. D2.
Main animated/floating artifact helper toolbar replaced by static Improve document dropdown above content. Action labels largely retained in new helper. D1.
Static Improve document dropdown uses native revision-targeted commands and disables while draft/busy. Functional polish/comment/log/format/analyze choices survive, placement changes. D1.
Run code moved to bottom; native execution result shown in details. Explicit saved revision, language/config gates, selected transcript result. Not the old client execution console. D1.
Main code artifact output console replaced by native tool execution result details. Preserve output/error visibility when restoring layout; do not restore old execution authority.
Loads prior native revision with skeleton/retry, reuses DiffView; adds Changes from version label. Comparison unavailable during local draft.

Immediate local edits + 2s save, sessionStorage recovery, serialized immutable requests, confirmed revision IDs, retry/discard. Main appended speculative cached revisions. Keep durability while aligning save UI. O4.
Main partial input title/content opened and updated streaming panel; last artifact selected richer preview. EVE waits for completed tool output. D3, D4.
Inline content preview, skeleton and expand hitbox removed; EVE emits writing text then compact result chip. D4.
Dedicated read renderer merged into EveDocumentTool; completed read uses common compact card and does not auto-open panel.
Pending output only; auto-opens on observed successful completion if panel closed. Already-visible panel is left unchanged, including explicit old revision selection. D3, D5.

Compact result card retained; adds read action, revision ID and disabled-before-client; removes always-true memo comparator. Regression lies in choosing only this compact view, not the chip itself. D4.
Existing loading skeleton retained; missing live preview is due to parent routing/state.
Header/title/actions/close primitives identical. No need to rewrite these to restore main styling.
Empty content now clears editor, read-only changes update editor state; existing text editor reused. Parent always supplies idle, so streaming loss is upstream. D3.
Keeps CodeMirror instance; reconfigures language/editability with Compartment, handles empty content and remote updates. Avoid reverting fixes for visual parity.
Distinct blank row arrays and preventGridDefault on edit selection; same grid view. Existing content-sync effect annotated.
Recreates span when diff styling changes; supports empty old/new content. Same general diff presentation.

Old inline image document preview removed with DocumentPreview. EVE documents cover text/code/sheet; image generation uses separate result path. Image-tool parity is outside this audit's verified scope.
Artifact registry/type framework replaced by explicit native components/actions. Lost capabilities cataloged in D1–D4 rather than treating every removed abstraction as a bug.
Only type imports moved; reset on branch change comes from provider key in EveArtifactLayout, not this hook. D6.
UIArtifact type moved and adds revisionId; retains streaming/title/content fields. Type supports preview even though EVE renderer does not currently use it. D3.
Text copy/diff/version actions and polish toolbar map to EVE actions/comparison/helper. Version restoration still missing. D1, D2.
Main run/console/version/copy/comments/logs split into EVE run/actions/helper. Native execution is deliberate; header placement differs. D1.
Version/copy/format/analyze move to EVE components. CSV copying and helper labels retained, previous/next placed at bottom. D1.
Preserves main helper labels/model choices and adds explicit target document/revision in request; sheet analyze additionally gated on code-document support.
Main session-aware ArtifactPanel wrapper replaced by native owned/read-only layout; layout lifetime differs. D6.
Resizable panes, min widths, mobile hide-main behavior retained; outer project page no longer uses this container. P1.
Native runtime/deletion providers replace main ChatProviders/ChatRouteHost. Keep layout-owned execution. Project list prefetch retained; legacy chat-list prefetch removed.
Main persistent chat and artifact provider ownership replaced by EVE runtime plus branch-keyed artifact provider. D6.
Main route host served chat/project surfaces through common chat shell; EVE routes render separate server/client surfaces. P1, P2.
New EVE welcome/guest/bootstrap composition; accepted first-message behavior. Empty header now has plain Chat/New conversation.
Native chat page resolves logical identity; stable logical URL accepted. Restore header metadata independently.
Server-owned auth/project/list reads replaced null route consumed by host. Browser MCP reports uncached dynamic data outside Suspense during project navigation. P2.
Checks project ownership then redirects to unqualified chat URL; loses project marker and return destination. H3.
Uses native public transcript component rather than main shared chat controller. Shared header badge missing in target view. H2.
Main shared surface replaced by EveSharedPage; native clone/copy handling retained separately.
Optimistic first send/recovery retained. On project page only composer/message area changes while ProjectConfig/history remain mounted until navigation, unlike main whole chat transition. P4.
First user bubble appears before admission completes; preserve it while changing outer project/header layout. Previous six-test verification applies, not rerun here.
Retains send intent and supports unavailable-project recovery; keep safety/error state when restoring main shell.
Logical path/sibling/slot behavior accepted; document actions and panel still receive selected native conversationId. D6. No branch-controller redesign proposed.
EVE-backed controlled composer used on project page. Full model/tool/attachment parity not re-audited; empty-project geometry captured but model preferences differ.
Shared controlled presentation replaces main provider-connected composer. Included to identify project layout dependency; full composer audit deferred.
Main provider-bound composer replaced by controlled/EVE composition; first-send behavior already accepted.
Main optimism contracts for chat rename/pin/delete, project rename and document save split across new hooks/controllers. Rename/pin optimism missing; document/deletion differences deliberate. O1–O4.
Project CRUD/instructions procedures unchanged; project UI changes come from callers, cache behavior and EVE association queries.
Logical metadata rename/pin/project/visibility procedures exist. Missing UI entry points should call these instead of restoring legacy chat procedures. O1.
Logical list ordering retains pinned-first, but no date headings; unspecified project filter includes project chats. Metadata identity/detail separated from paginated lists. S3, O1.
